business_recommendations.recommendation: Promote festive bulk gifting packages with upfront tiered discount options.
business_recommendations.why: Customers actively seek bulk discounts for festival gifting.

business_recommendations.recommendation: Maintain steady inventory of fresh dairy staples like Amul butter 500g.
business_recommendations.why: High-demand essentials drive repeat customer visits and hold-for-pickup requests.

business_recommendations.recommendation: Offer a budget/economy variety of rice for price-conscious customers asking for low rates.
business_recommendations.why: Fatima Sheikh initially sought ration card rates, indicating interest in lower-cost staple options.

business_recommendations.recommendation: Proactively inform customers about delivery delays before deadline passes.
business_recommendations.why: Waiting for the customer to follow up after a missed promise damages customer trust.

business_recommendations.recommendation: Arrange backup delivery arrangements when regular delivery personnel are absent.
business_recommendations.why: Prevents repeated delivery failures for loyal customers like Geeta Devi.

business_recommendations.recommendation: Perform regular maintenance and daily calibration checks on all weighing machines.
business_recommendations.why: Repeated quantity errors severely damage customer trust and lead to churn.

business_recommendations.recommendation: Set a monthly reminder for the 1st of each month to pack and deliver the specific Maggi brand order for Rajesh Traders.

business_recommendations.recommendation: Implement an order verification checklist prior to dispatch.
business_recommendations.why: Prevents incomplete deliveries and maintains customer trust.

business_recommendations.recommendation: Proactively notify regular customers about wholesale price changes for basic staples.
